UNWIND c.official_language AS lang
RETURN DISTINCT lang;","rationale":"The query first finds politicians who have held at least one position whose name includes typical head‑of‑state keywords (e.g., "President", "Head of State") and at least one position whose name includes typical head‑of‑government keywords (e.g., "Prime Minister", "Premier").   AND (
      c.name IN [gov.name, st.name] OR
      any(a IN c.aliases WHERE a IN [gov.name, st.name])

WITH c ORDER BY c.founding_date ASC
